name: Photographe de Teyvat/15.07.2022
description: 1=Olah! Hello, Travelers~ The Golden Apple Archipelago is now available in Version 2.8, the exclusive summer islands in Teyvat are back! Have you started your new adventure yet? At the same time, the #Photographer of Teyvat event series is also back! In #Photographer of Teyvat Part II, I have prepared four events for you which will be available respectively on July 15, July 22, July 29, and August 5. Don't forget to check for updates in time! Travelers who actively participate will have the opportunity to win Primogems!
